description: This file defines an immutable wrapper struct and an extension method in C# for the Orleans distributed framework. It provides a generic readonly struct 'Immutable<T>' to encapsulate data that should be treated as immutable, optimizing message serialization in Orleans. Additionally, it includes an extension method 'AsImmutable()' for easy conversion of objects to their immutable wrapper form.

classes.name: Immutable<T>
classes.description: A generic readonly struct that wraps a value of type T to signify immutability within Orleans messaging.

methods.name: Immutable
methods.description: Constructor for the Immutable struct that initializes the wrapped value.

classes.name: ImmutableExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for all objects to convert them into Immutable wrappers.

methods.name: AsImmutable
methods.description: An extension method that wraps the provided value in an Immutable<T> wrapper.
